text: Keeps crashing on startup after the v3.2 update. I can't even open the app to log in anymore — happens on iPhone 14, iOS 17.4. Refunded would be nice.
Love the new dark mode! It's exactly what I've been waiting for, and the contrast is spot on.
Hi team, can we get a Slack integration so order alerts post to our #ops channel? Would save us copy-pasting from the dashboard ten times a day.
Got charged twice for the annual renewal — once on April 17 and again on April 19. Same card, same email. Please refund the duplicate.
Just tried the export feature and lost two hours of work. The CSV came out empty and the original draft is gone. Furious.
Sign-up flow asked me for my company tax ID before I could even see the product. Felt like a wall, almost bounced.
Found something concerning: I was able to view another customer's invoice by editing the URL parameter from /invoice/4421 to /invoice/4422. Please look into this.
Five stars. Best calendar app I've used in a decade. Rock solid sync across three devices.
Yeah, super helpful. I've only spent four hours trying to figure out how to cancel my trial. Smooth experience.
The keyboard input gets lost when I rotate from portrait to landscape on iPad — typed a whole reply, rotated, blank text field. Reproducible 100% of the time.
Onboarding tour kept restarting every time I closed the app. Eventually figured out I had to tap a tiny X in the corner. Took me ten minutes.
Fine I guess. Does what it says.
Can you add a way to bulk-tag customers? We import 2000 contacts a week and tagging one at a time is killing us.
App is good but the push notifications come through twice every time. Already turned off duplicates in settings, no change.
Pricing page didn't make it clear that the "Pro" plan was billed annually. I clicked subscribe expecting $19, got charged $228. Want a refund.
The new analytics dashboard is gorgeous. Whoever designed it deserves a raise.
Anyone else seeing data loss on the iOS share extension? I shared three articles to the app and only one made it through. Opened a ticket but no response in 48 hours.
Pretty good app. Battery drain is noticeable on my Pixel 7 — drops about 8% an hour with the app in foreground.
It would be nice to have a way to schedule recurring tasks. Currently I duplicate the task each week which is annoying but workable.
Looking forward to the v4 release. Keep up the great work team. — Marina
